dedupe_keys.name: dataset of future district heating energy demand in a finnish municipality

description: The deposit contains future district-heating demand scenarios and supplementary material examining climate, efficiency and population changes. It provides MATLAB files for power, temperature and model configurations. The provider is Jean-Nicolas Louis; Petri Hietaharju; Jari Pulkkinen. Coverage: The case is Jyväskylä, Finland, with model years 2013, 2030 and 2050 and hourly heating-season resolution. These include future scenarios, not future observations. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: The provider explicitly withholds district-network and building datasets for copyright reasons. The shared files are therefore not a complete reproduction package. For simulation it supports comparison of long-term heat-demand assumptions and climate-related sensitivity. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
